root_cause: Both validators store seconds as binary64: libxml2 xmlSchemaValDate.sec is double; the pinned Xerces-J AbstractDateTimeDV.DateTimeData.second is double (verified with javap). Fractions differing beyond binary64 precision collapse to one enumeration value. Exact rational comparisons and the independent XMLGregorianCalendar BigDecimal value API distinguish them.

jdk_value_api_discrepancies.root_cause: XMLGregorianCalendarImpl.compare normalizes unknown-zone endpoints with normalizeToTimezone/add. add restores undefined year/month/day fields after carrying the clock across midnight, so internalCompare sees only wrapped clock fields and reports an ordering where the arbitrary-date comparison is indeterminate. Explicit common-date comparisons preserve these carries.
